Checking whether external loads are single-threaded.

The race condition remains unresolved because Checkstyle can be embedded and Main is not guaranteed to be single-threaded. I will run one bounded CLI reproduction to independently confirm the three cases, then write the review. I agree this is not a P0.

argv:
import subprocess, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/output/csfix'); p.mkdir(parents=True)
(p/'marker.txt').write_text('SYNTHMARKER')
(p/'ok.dtd').write_text('<!ELEMENT module (property)*>
<!ATTLIST module name CDATA #IMPLIED>
<!ELEMENT property EMPTY>
<!ATTLIST property name CDATA #IMPLIED value CDATA #IMPLIED>
')
(p/'Stub.java').write_text('public class Stub {}
')
(p/'system-ok.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE module SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/ok.dtd">
<module name="Checker"/>
')
(p/'system-bad.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE module SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/marker.txt">
<module name="Checker"/>
')
(p/'ge.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE module [
<!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/marker.txt">
]>
<module name="Checker">&ext;</module>
')
(p/'nodtd.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>
<module name="Checker"/>
')
java=['/runtime/jdk/bin/java','-XX:+UseSerialGC','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1','-Xmx256m','-cp','/runtime/classes:/runtime/lib/*','com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main']
for cfg in ['nodtd.xml','system-ok.xml','system-bad.xml','ge.xml']:
    r=subprocess.run(java+['-c',str(p/cfg),str(p/'Stub.java')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
    blob=(r.stdout or '')+'
'+(r.stderr or '')
    print('CASE',cfg,'rc',r.returncode,'marker',('SYNTHMARKER' in blob),'n',len(blob))
    line=next((ln.strip() for ln in blob.splitlines() if ln.strip() and not ln.startswith('	')), '')
    print(line[:240])
    print('---')
